title: Bloodstone
content:
# Bloodstone

Type: Material | Internal ID: GemstoneRed | Source: Charred Fortress | Usage: Building, Crafting, Upgrading | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Bloodstone is a material used to craft the "Blood" version of some Ashlands weapons. They have a chance to be found in the Charred chests inside Charred Fortresses located in Ashlands.
A weapon upgraded with Bloodstone has its damage increased by 0.2% for every HP the player is missing. It is not HP the target is missing.

### Building

• Gem cutter

### Crafting

• Bleeding Berserkir axes
• Bloodgeon
• Blood Fang
• Brutal Slayer
• Dundr
• Dyrnwyn
• Jörmundling
• Nidhögg the Bleeding
• Splitnir the Bleeding
• Trollstav
• Wound Ripper

## Trivia

There is a creature (internal ID "Goblin_Gem") that never appears in the actual game, but can be spawned using the console, that drops all three kinds of Ashlands gemstones.

Categorias: Materials, Gems
